items.title: 0.42.0-alpha
items.summary: ROB-973: harden kubernetes-remediation file-read policy defaults in t… …he Helm chart ( #2479 ) Chart side of [ROB-973]( https://linear.app/robusta/issue/ROB-973/holmes-mcp-integrations-codex-h01-auto-approved-container-file-reads ) / [ROB-1103]( https://linear.app/robusta/issue/ROB-1103 ). Server side: robusta-dev/holmes-mcp-integrations PR "ROB-973: harden read_file_from_container path policy" (image `1.4.0`). ## What was wrong `mcpAddons.kubernetesRemediation.config.fileReadAllowedPaths` defaulted to `"/"`, so the auto-approved `read_file_from_container` tool (cluster-wide `pods/exec`) could read any file in any pod except three denied prefixes. Verified on a k3s cluster: GCP/AWS credential files, `.env`, TLS keys and a symlink into a Secret mount were all returned to the caller. The LLM instructions also told the model `/proc` was readable (the server hard-denies it) and that only secret/token mounts were refused. ## What changed - `fileReadAllowedPaths` default → `/app,/config,/data,/etc,/home,/opt,/srv,/tmp,/usr,/var/lib,/var/log,/var/tmp,/var/www,/workspace`. Honoured by the currently pinned `1.2.0` image. - New `fileReadRequireCanonicalization: true`, wired as `KUBECTL_FILE_READ_REQUIRE_CANONICALIZATION` through the ConfigMap and container env. Server `>= 1.4.0` refuses reads the container cannot resolve with `readlink -f`; older images ignore the variable, so this is safe on `1.2.0`. - Values comment documents the server's non-configurable hard-denied roots/patterns and how to make the tool approval-gated (`approvalRequiredTools`). - `_helpers.tpl` LLM instructions and `docs/data-sources/builtin-toolsets/kubernetes-remediation-mcp.md` corrected. ## Verification ``` $ helm template t helm/holmes --set mcpAddons.kubernetesRemediation.enabled=true --set mcpAddons.kubernetesRemediation.auth.existingSecret=x | grep KUBECTL_FILE_READ KUBECTL_FILE_READ_ALLOWED_PATHS: "/app,/config,/data,/etc,/home,/opt,/srv,/tmp,/usr,/var/lib,/var/log,/var/tmp,/var/www,/workspace"
